description: Existing exceptions to the front-end rules of tools/architecture-rules/frontend.mjs (docs/ENFORCEMENT.md, sections l to o). Measured on 31 October 2026; remove entries as they are fixed. Do not add entries without a reason.

jquery.reason: jqueryTrigger() is the one bridge that re-fires learner events as jQuery events for add-ons that still listen with .on(); it only runs when a theme or add-on loaded jQuery.
triggerLegacy() fires the legacy body events (added_to_cart, payment_method_selected, …) that gateway add-ons listen for; no-op without jQuery.
Gateway and cart add-ons receive the clicked button as a jQuery object in the legacy cart events; plain element without jQuery.
Classic payment gateway handlers' open( response, $form ) and resume( $form ) hooks receive a jQuery-wrapped form.
Listens for the legacy video tracker's jQuery event (ohmylms:video:completed) that add-on players still trigger.

featureImports.reason: Import cycle: both components reach question-bank/public.mjs (MultipleChoiceBlock directly, QuestionLivePreview through InteractiveEditors), whose model.mjs imports the question type models from question-editor/public.mjs, so that file cannot re-export them.
Side-effect import that registers the paper blocks before the question blocks; webpack drops a public.mjs that is imported only for its side effects, so it would not load the registration.

question-editor/public.mjs holds only .mjs models because question-bank/model.mjs, paper/paperTypes.mjs and learning/choiceAutosave.mjs load it in Node tests, which cannot load JSX; the rich content control opens the media library with this component.
